about: Conformance vectors for extractor 1's file documents (DESIGN-DETAILS section 11.2; protocol/INDEX-FORMAT.md's Extractor 1). path is the file's path (path_x, in hex, when it is not printable UTF-8) and input the file, written as in mail.json. binary marks a file that gives no document. Each document gives fields 4 (the title, one space and the path) and 5 (the chunk's text), and text, keys and row as in mail.json, the row's title being the title alone.

bad byte n md   bad byte
